title: Month sign-off
sub: Check and sign off the timesheets of your team. Signed-off months are locked.
explain: After sign-off, the time entries, absences and balance adjustments of that person in that month are read-only for everyone, administrators included. Only an administrator can reopen a month, with a reason that is logged.
nobody: Nobody to sign off for this month.
reopen_help: The month becomes editable again. The person and the original signer are notified, and the reason is stored in the change log.
confirm_message: The month becomes read-only for everyone. Only an administrator can reopen it. You can add a note.
integrity_help: Recomputes the fingerprint of every signed-off month, checks the cryptographic seals and their chain, and compares today's figures with the signed statement. This detects changes made directly in the database file, bypassing RESORIXtrack, and rule changes that altered a signed month retroactively.
integrity_ok: All {n} sign-offs are intact and all database guards are active.
integrity_problems: Problems found: the following sign-offs do not match their seal.
guards_missing: {n} database guard(s) are missing. Restart the app (it re-installs them) and check how this happened.
